targetTexts.1: My son, if you have put up security for your neighbor, if you have struck hands in pledge with a stranger,
targetTexts.2: if you have been trapped by the words of your lips, ensnared by the words of your mouth,
targetTexts.3: then do this, my son, to free yourself, for you have fallen into your neighbor’s hands: Go, humble yourself, and press your plea with your neighbor.
targetTexts.4: Allow no sleep to your eyes or slumber to your eyelids.
targetTexts.5: Free yourself, like a gazelle from the hand of the hunter, like a bird from the snare of the fowler.
targetTexts.6: Walk in the manner of the ant, O slacker; observe its ways and become wise.
targetTexts.7: Without a commander, without an overseer or ruler,
targetTexts.8: it prepares its provisions in summer; it gathers its food at harvest.
targetTexts.9: How long will you lie there, O slacker? When will you get up from your sleep?
targetTexts.10: A little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to rest,
targetTexts.11: and poverty will come upon you like a robber, and need like a bandit.
targetTexts.12: A worthless person, a wicked man, walks with a perverse mouth,
targetTexts.13: winking his eyes, speaking with his feet, and pointing with his fingers.
targetTexts.14: With deceit in his heart he devises evil; he continually sows discord.
targetTexts.15: Therefore calamity will come upon him suddenly; in an instant he will be shattered beyond recovery.
targetTexts.16: There are six things that the LORD hates, seven that are detestable to Him:
targetTexts.17: haughty eyes, a lying tongue, hands that shed innocent blood,
targetTexts.18: a heart that devises wicked schemes, feet that run swiftly to evil,
targetTexts.19: a false witness who gives false testimony, and one who stirs up discord among brothers.
targetTexts.20: My son, keep your father’s commandment, and do not forsake your mother’s teaching.
targetTexts.21: Bind them always upon your heart; tie them around your neck.
targetTexts.22: When you walk, they will guide you; when you lie down, they will watch over you; when you awake, they will speak to you.
targetTexts.23: For this commandment is a lamp, this teaching is a light, and the reproofs of discipline are the way to life,
targetTexts.24: to keep you from the evil woman, from the smooth tongue of the adulteress.
targetTexts.25: Do not lust in your heart for her beauty or let her captivate you with her eyes.
targetTexts.26: For the levy of the prostitute is poverty, and the adulteress preys upon your very life.
targetTexts.27: Can a man embrace fire and his clothes not be burned?
targetTexts.28: Can a man walk on hot coals without scorching his feet?
targetTexts.29: So is he who sleeps with another man’s wife; no one who touches her will go unpunished.
targetTexts.30: Men do not despise the thief if he steals to satisfy his hunger.
targetTexts.31: Yet if caught, he must pay sevenfold; he must give up all the wealth of his house.
targetTexts.32: He who commits adultery lacks judgment; whoever does so destroys himself.
targetTexts.33: Wounds and dishonor will befall him, and his reproach will never be wiped away.
targetTexts.34: For jealousy enrages a husband, and he will show no mercy in the day of vengeance.
targetTexts.35: He will not be appeased by any ransom, or persuaded by lavish gifts.
